method: Statewide races combine polls with an assumed wide 2024 presidential state-lean prior (SD 10 points when adjusted by a fresh national generic ballot, otherwise SD 12). Sparse statewide polling adds a 4-point uncertainty term. Prior weights and uncertainty are assumptions, not fitted or calibrated. House races retain the original multi-poll requirement because district history is missing. Generic ballot entries are not district forecasts. Poll input method: latest observation per pollster and current candidate pair; 14-day recency half-life; square-root sample weight capped at 1500; partisan/internal polls half weight. Normal margin model with assumed 4-point shared error floor, poll disagreement, sampling, undecided and time terms. These assumptions have NOT been fitted or validated against historical outcomes. Poll percentages are not win probabilities. Historical state lean is not an incumbency or candidate-quality model. Maine gubernatorial general election uses plurality; federal Maine and Alaska races remain withheld. No chamber-control odds: complete race roster and correlated seat model not implemented. States without usable polls are unknown, not necessarily states without elections.
